entities.name: Prosthetic valve endocarditis
observations: Late prosthetic-valve infective endocarditis may present subacutely with constitutional symptoms and new valvular regurgitation.

entities.name: Coagulase-negative Staphylococcus spp.
observations: Coagulase-negative staphylococci, particularly Staphylococcus epidermidis, are characteristic causes of prosthetic-valve endocarditis and may cause an indolent course.
